purpose: The B2 (Phase 3D-4) checks of the jq 1.8.2 / Windows x64 pilot wiring, mapped to the requirements of the B2 task, with the exact test identifiers that exercise them. Every test is DEVELOPER-AUTHORED and runs on synthetic bytes (a consistent copy of the committed pilot pieces re-pinned to made-up bytes); none of them is independent evidence by itself. tools/run_staging.py --manifest <this file> runs exactly these identifiers and fails if one is missing, renamed, ignored or failing. The real jq bytes are never read, copied, hashed or executed by any of them.

requirements.title: The default build cannot install jq; the pilot configuration is Windows-only, narrow and has no shortcut
The real jq bytes stay LOCKED even in the pilot configuration (one constant, off; the provider and the enablement list are empty)
The independent B1 decision is bound to the exact recipe; missing or modified review evidence and every tampered piece close the supply
Catalog identity: the recipe's tool id is the catalog row's id and nothing else is seeded
The whole path on synthetic bytes: catalog, details, preview (every disclosure), consent, result, installed details, restart, removal; no external change
Consent bound to the preview, single-use, replay and stale offers refused; concurrent confirmations install once
Audit write failure: needs_attention with the true state, reconciled by recovery; mandatory pre-installation row
Rollback at every injected failure point and a clean retry
Filesystem and provider safety: unexpected files, links, junctions, changed identity, ownership conflicts, replaced files

titles: the jq pilot preview discloses the licence scope, the stored file name and that the file is never run or put on PATH

notReproducibleInCi: The real application window with the jq-pilot build: needs WebView2 and a desktop session (tools/gui_install_flow.ps1 drives the synthetic-pilot build; the jq-pilot build is checked by its own headless/GUI notes in docs/phase-3d4).
Smart App Control / Defender reaction to a real executable: needs the real file; never part of B2.
Operating-system level network isolation: not available without administrator rights.
